text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 7.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 8. Copy of article or papers published 9.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 10.Academic Reference 11.Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. 12.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).
